title: Miniature figures
content: If you ever need small figures to populate a reference miniature or architectural maquette, you can find these sets of unpainted plastic figures from a model railroad supplier. They're shown here next to a raccoon skull and a mouse skull and an inch ruler for comparison. Typically the poses are standing and sitting.They generally come in white unpainted plastic or painted. You can get them in sets, where the cost averages about a dollar each. They are scaled to all thestandard model railroad sizes, such as HO, S, O,etc.I found the unpainted ones in Great Britain, but you can also get them on Amazon:HO People
